purpose.objective: Qualify environment-specific academy harness support against canonical common contracts while preserving native runtime and credential ownership.
successCriteria: ENV-01 distinguishes declared, implemented, configured and behaviorally verified support separately for Codex, Antigravity, Muse, Claude, Grok CLI and Hermes TUI including the named Hermes-agent-2q3y target.
Evidence covers identity, delegation, dependency, continuity, verification and completion without substituting logical IDs for native execution/session IDs.
ENV-02 prepares bounded owner-local handoff contracts after qualified DOM-02, reusing common implementations and retaining explicit unsupported/unknown capabilities.
No source-only qualification is promoted into native adoption, deployment, common-contract approval or teacher acceptance.
inScope: Metadata/code inspection of approved academy source and common/native adapter contracts.
Read-only version/capability checks of the host and named Hermes target only; typed source proposals and synthetic handoff checks.
outOfScope: No native config, credentials, permissions, execution loops, sessions, services or private stores modified.
No common contracts/dependency pins changed or unrelated Work resumed.
No publication, merge, deployment, native activation, student data reads/writes, printing/sending or third-session messages.
